title: The AI Privacy Switch Most Tools Hide

scenes.narration: An AI tool can run locally and still send your data to the cloud. Local is a location. Privacy is a data-flow decision.
scenes.onScreenText: Local does not automatically mean private

scenes.narration: The useful question is not where the interface runs. Ask where the model runs, where files are stored, and whether telemetry leaves the device.
scenes.onScreenText: Trace the data, not the label

scenes.narration: A practical check has three steps. Input enters the app. The app chooses a model endpoint. Then logs, files, or prompts may be retained somewhere else.
In code, make the endpoint and logging choices explicit. A local URL is evidence. It is not proof that every other service is disabled.
This creates a more useful comparison. Fully local keeps model calls and files on-device. A hybrid workflow may keep files local but send selected prompts remotely.
So do not buy the word local. Draw the data flow. Check the endpoint, storage, and telemetry. That is the privacy test you can repeat for any AI tool.
